description: This file defines FastAPI routes for CRUD operations on medical records, including role-based access controls and interactions with a MongoDB database.

methods.name: MedicalRecord _record_from_doc(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Maps a MongoDB medical record document to MedicalRecord model.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_patient_id_for_user(db, user_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches the patient ID associated with a user ID from the database.

methods.name: List[MedicalRecord] list_medical_records( patient_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by patient id (required for doctors)"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Lists medical records accessible to the current user, with role-based filtering.

methods.name: MedicalRecord create_medical_record( payload: MedicalRecordCreate, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required(["admin", "doctor"])), )
methods.description: Creates a new medical record for a patient, restricted to admin and doctor roles.

methods.name: MedicalRecord get_medical_record( record_id: str = Path(..., description="Medical record id"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific medical record with access control based on user role.

methods.name: MedicalRecord update_medical_record( record_id: str, payload: MedicalRecordUpdate, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required(["admin", "doctor"])), )
methods.description: Updates entries of a medical record, restricted to admin and doctor roles.

methods.name: None delete_medical_record( record_id: str, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required(["admin"])), )
methods.description: Deletes a medical record, restricted to admin role.

ctags.name: get_medical_record
ctags.signature: ( record_id: str = Path(..., description="Medical record id"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: list_medical_records
ctags.signature: ( patient_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by patient id (required for doctors)"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: update_medical_record
ctags.signature: ( record_id: str, payload: MedicalRecordUpdate, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required(["admin", "doctor"])), )
